deployment_artifacts.purpose: Bicep reference for API and scanner sidecar-style jobs in Azure Container Apps.
Local and customer-lab reference stack for API plus metadata-only scanner.
Kubernetes packaging baseline for private clusters and managed Kubernetes.
End-to-end reproducible demo path and validation commands.
Customer-side operating checklist for metadata-only scanner execution.
Azure infrastructure skeleton for Container Apps, registry, logging, and storage boundaries.

scanner_boundary.egress: metadata-only hashes, scores, findings, and evidence references

security_controls.description: Runtime gates must deny risky actions when policy, identity, or approval context is missing.
Scanner output is limited to hashes, risk scores, findings, and evidence references.
Raw model weights, training data, prompts, source code, and secrets cannot leave the boundary.
Deployment examples support private endpoint or internal-only network operation.
Outputs point to signed evidence artifacts rather than raw private data.
Every deployment path requires tenant and workspace scope variables.
